svg.title: InnoDB undo reconstruction and A's visibility
svg.desc: Teaching model for the visibility-operations schedule. A's Repeatable Read view is established at its first consistent read of 100. After B commits 150, the clustered record is current at 150; undo information reconstructs 100 for A's consistent read. A's locking read returns 150 but the next consistent read still returns 100. A updates the current 150 to 200 and sees its own write before commit. B reads 150 before that commit and 200 afterward.

g.text: A's RR view: first consistent table read sees 100
DB_TRX_ID identifies writer; DB_ROLL_PTR links undo
Undo information reconstructs an earlier version
Visible to A's retained consistent-read view
Current balance 200: A's uncommitted own write
A consistent read: 200; B consistent read: 150
After A commits: B's fresh read returns 200
Simplified visibility model, not the complete algorithm
